article.title: Smartly推出Intelligence Pro，把媒體規劃與增量訊號放進同一平台
article.title_en: Smartly launches Intelligence Pro for media planning and incrementality signals
article.summary: Smartly於11月2日推出付費進階服務，供符合資格的客戶使用。
article.summary_en: Smartly announced a premium service for eligible customers on November 2.
highlights: Reach Planner預測跨渠道觸及與頻次；Headroom Analysis評估加碼空間。
INCRMNTAL Connect把增量貢獻訊號與平台數據並列。
highlights_en: Reach Planner forecasts reach and frequency; Headroom Analysis assesses spending headroom.
INCRMNTAL Connect adds contribution signals alongside platform reporting.
article.why: 媒體團隊可在規劃預算時，同時查看平台表現與額外生意貢獻的估算。
article.why_en: Media teams can compare platform performance with estimates of additional business contribution.
article.next_step: 先問清楚數據需求、模型假設及方案資格，再用一個市場作比較。
article.next_step_en: Check data requirements, model assumptions and eligibility, then compare one market.
article.detail: 這項服務亦包括Benchmarks，以彙總及匿名數據，按行業、地區、平台及目標比較表現。四項工具處理規劃、加碼空間、同業比較與增量訊號等不同問題，不能把預測或模型估算直接當成已實現收入。官方列明只供符合資格的Smartly客戶使用，未公布統一價格；新聞稿中的客戶感言亦不代表所有廣告主可獲相同結果。
article.detail_en: Benchmarks uses aggregated, anonymized data across industries, regions, platforms and objectives. Forecasts and modeled incrementality are not realized revenue. Eligibility applies; the release gives no standard price or universal outcome guarantee.
article.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
